original: WPRPLACE is a waterfall in Hengifossá in Fljótsdalur, Eastern Iceland, also known as Stuðlabergsfoss [ˈstʏðlaˌpɛrksˌfɔsː, -ˌpɛr̥s-]. The waterfall is about 30 meters high and forms an apron in a cliff. The waterfall is in a large rock choir with an unusually regular supporting rock made of high and straight columns.
translated: WPRPLACE ist ein Wasserfall in Hengifossá in Fljótsdalur, Ostisland, auch bekannt als Stuðlabergsfoss [ˈstʏðlaˌpɛrksˌfɔsː, -ˌpɛr̥s-]. Der Wasserfall ist etwa 30 Meter hoch und bildet eine Schürze in einer Klippe.
